biography.title: Biography
biography.caption: Marjolène Lasne, her brushes and easel
paragraphs: Marjolène Lasne is a French painter based in Provence. Her work, deeply rooted in Mediterranean light, explores landscapes, terraces, and interior scenes with a unique sensitivity.

Trained at the Beaux-Arts de Paris, she quickly developed a personal style characterized by luminous compositions and warm color palettes inspired by the South of France. Her work has been exhibited in numerous galleries in France and internationally.

She now divides her time between creating, teaching, and artistic residencies. Passionate about sharing her art, Marjolène regularly conducts workshops and supports emerging artists in their artistic development.

studio.title: Studio and Exhibition Space
studio.caption: Marjolène's studio in Roussillon
paragraphs: Marjolène's studio is located in the heart of Roussillon, in Provence, in a former ochre quarry transformed into a vibrant creative space. This is where her artistic universe takes shape, cradled by Mediterranean colors and landscapes.
This space regularly welcomes visitors interested in her creative process. Marjolène organizes private visits and workshops where she shares her passion for painting and color.
Featuring a large workspace with exceptional natural light, the studio is also a meeting place for artists. Marjolène hosts regular workshops, artistic residencies, and temporary exhibitions.
